subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: What Is White-Box Testing
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on What Is White-Box Testing.

hook.text: You open the vending machine and look at every gear, wire, and circuit. Now you test each one. That's white-box.

buildup.text: White-box testing examines internal code structure—paths, branches, conditions, and loops.

discovery.text: It verifies that every line of code executes and every decision branch is taken at least once.

twist.text: White-box tests can pass with 100% coverage and still miss bugs—if the specification itself was wrong.

climax.text: Combining white-box (does the code work correctly?) with black-box (does it meet requirements?) gives full coverage.

punchline.text: Black-box tests what it should do. White-box tests how it does it.

quiz.question: What does white-box testing examine?
options: Internal code structure, paths, and branches
